X2_matches.how: TFloatAutomationInterpolator vtable slot +0x08 target; same branch structure (end-of-list hold, event-time, equal-value, has-curve, linear); both use FMA in the linear branch; reads grid consts 105b3eac0/8 (arm 1055d96xx)

X2_matches.role: Float evaluator public entry (builds transform record)
X2_matches.how: calls automation +0x238 then record builder then the evaluator
same handle layout {converter,range,flag}; full-range record makes the transform identity

X2_matches.role: converter apply (slot +0x28; no-op when converter ptr null)
curve value (absolute Bezier + bisection, range clamp)
X2_matches.how: same callee cluster; bisection tolerance 1e-8 (105d65f20 / arm 3e45798ee2308c3a)
AFloatEvent post-load calls it on (0,x1,x2,1) and (0,y1,y2,1); same discriminant/root logic (research REQ-009)
vtable slot +0x08; mode 0 = last event before t, mode 1 = last at t; no converter requested
movsbl 0x58; AFloatEvent/AEnumEvent getters at the same vtable slot +0x1f0

X2_matches.role: Pan ALinearUserFloatConverter ctor / slot +0x28 (A1, display path, not used by automation)
X2_matches.how: built by the track device with (-1,1,0.015873,0.01); slot +0x28 is identity on the parameter range

X2_matches.role: Volume ALevelUserFloatConverter ctor / slot +0x28 (display path, dB log table)
X2_matches.how: track-device Volume display converter; log2 dB table FUN_101ae2d30(10); not reached by the automation evaluator

X2_matches.role: automation conversion setup with NULL converter
X2_matches.how: builds the automation's conversion provider with converter = 0, so E(t) stays in stored units (A1)
